description: Aurora agent surface (no LLM cost — pure DB write). Star or unstar a top-level agent for quick sidebar access. Mirrors PATCH /api/agent/:agentId/star. Address by agentId OR exact title (XOR). Omit starred to toggle.

agentId.description: MongoDB agent _id to star or unstar (XOR with title)

starred.description: Optional explicit star state. Omit to toggle the current state.

title.description: Exact case-insensitive user-assigned title (XOR with agentId)

name: star_agent
